added_observations.denominator: Mexico residents aged 12+ who read a book in the past 12 months; exact reader subgroup n unpublished
added_observations.population: Mexico residents aged 12+; national urban and rural coverage; book reader subset
added_observations.evidence_locator: Report 55/26 printed p.10 (PDF index 9), Figure 7, 2026 bars; methods pp.2 to 4, book recall period p.4
added_observations.notes: Published 18 November 2026; fieldwork 2 June to 3 July 2026, face-to-face mobile interviews. The survey sampled 4820 dwellings, including 2336 in the 32-city aggregate and 2484 elsewhere; these dwelling counts are not the book reader denominator. Book reading has a past-12-month recall period. Multiple responses can overlap. Original Spanish categories retained and paper or digital formats remain combined. Report 55/26 describes the national age 12+ population, while the press-release introduction describes the programme as covering literate residents. The displayed denominator is explicitly the book reader subset. The report reproduces the existing 2025 genre percentages in the same chart; prior rows and source definitions are preserved. No audiobook genre split is published. Do not combine this national series with the pre-2025 urban age 18+ series. Reviewed 20 November 2026.

other_rechecks.decision: No new comparable annual book or audiobook figures located in the bounded review. AAP's latest visible monthly release remains August 2026, published 14 October. Annual values remain separate from monthly and cumulative results.
17 and 19 November entries cover publicity and career case studies. No new annual monetary release located.
Latest quantitative trade report remains the separately reviewed 28 October third-quarter report. November listings are title ranks or other news.
The November monitor still reports October retail change of 2.7 percent and January to October change of minus 2.0 percent. This edition was already reviewed and remains monthly retail context.
No new annual country monetary release located in the bounded source search. Finland's previously unresolved annual audiobook discrepancy stays on hold.
